annotations.title: The weather ahead and the long-term climate over a country or a region

description:
The next 1 to 7 days' weather danger over a whole country or region, day by day: the worst class reached, its hazard, the share of the area at each class, the worst point and the cities most at risk; with categories or layers, also long-term climate layers over the area (mean, 10th and 90th percentile, share at or above a value).

Use for "how bad is the weather in Japan this week", "how much of Spain faces high heat tomorrow", "how much of Bangladesh floods in a 100-year flood". One place: get_forecast or get_climate_profile.

above.description: With categories or layers: give each layer's share of the area at or above this value, in the layer's own unit (1.0 with flood_riverine/inundation: the share under at least 1 m of a 100-year river flood). The flood layers give it at 0.5 m when omitted

bbox.description: Or the area is this region, as [west, south, east, north] in degrees; across 180, give east past 180

categories.description: Also read the long-term climate layers of these categories over the area. misc holds Köppen climate zone, now and in 2050 and 2080, solar radiation, solar radiation of the sunniest month, surface runoff; fetch catalog:layers lists every layer

country.description: The area is this country or territory: its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (e.g. JPN) or its name

days.description: The window: the next 1 to 7 days from now

hazard.description: Only this hazard; every hazard when omitted

layers.description: Also read these climate layers over the area, by id, e.g. flood_riverine/inundation; fetch catalog:layers lists every id

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give
